annotation.bound_parties_text: The implementation opinion is issued by seven central government departments and directs government authorities, and encourages enterprises (producers, retailers, platforms) and financial institutions, to promote commodity consumption.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 鼓励家电销售企业联合生产、回收企业开展促销活动。
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 加快人工智能手机和电脑、智能穿戴设备、智能机器人、智能家居等产品推广应用。
